## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `1.3.1`, `3.3.1`, `3.3.3`

- Described-by is the relationship; colour alone is not the error signal (1.4.1, 3.3.1).
- The message says what is wrong and, where possible, how to fix it (3.3.3).
